name: ADMA Biologics, Inc.
tagline: End-to-end commercial biopharmaceutical company dedicated to manufacturing specialty biologics
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal moteur de croissance de l'entreprise, bénéficiant de l'approbation FDA en avril 2025 du processus innovant d'amélioration des rendements qui augmente la production de 20% ou plus à partir du même volume de plasma source

kpis.signal: Substantial revenue growth driven by expanded prescriber and patient base
kpis.description: Revenue from ASCENIV, plasma-derived IVIG for treatment of Primary Immunodeficiency in adults and adolescents, with commercial sales commenced October 2019

kpis.explanation: Net income of the company on GAAP basis
kpis.yoy: Achieved for first time in company history
kpis.signal: First net income achievement in company history achieved in fiscal year 2024, continued into 2025
kpis.description: Net income on GAAP basis for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, representing first profitability milestone in company history

kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities
kpis.signal: Positive cash flow from operations achieved and sustained
kpis.description: Positive cash flow from operations of $118.7 million for fiscal year 2024, continued throughout fiscal year 2025

kpis.signal: Anticipated continued margin expansion in fiscal 2026 from yield enhancement process
kpis.description: Gross margin expected to expand in fiscal 2026 with first full year of yield-enhanced production

stories_kpis.name_fr: Amélioration du rendement de production ASCENIV
stories_kpis.explanation: Production yield increase from innovative yield enhancement process
stories_kpis.signal: FDA approval of Prior Approval Supplement in April 2025 enabling 20% or more yield increase
stories_kpis.description: Innovative yield enhancement production process approved by FDA in April 2025 increases ASCENIV and BIVIGAM production yields by 20% or more from same starting source plasma volume

stories_kpis.explanation: Number of FDA-licensed source plasma collection centers operated
stories_kpis.yoy: Reduced from 8 to 7 following divestiture in December 2025
stories_kpis.signal: Strategic divestiture of 3 centers completed with long-term plasma supply agreements executed
stories_kpis.description: ADMA BioCenters operates plasma collection centers, reduced from 8 to 7 following December 2025 divestiture as part of shift to capital-efficient supply model

ai_positioning.summary: ADMA Biologics uses artificial intelligence in its supply chain and production operations. The company has implemented a strategy to improve the efficiency of its manufacturing capacity, enhance yields, strengthen supply chain robustness, and improve in-house fill and finish capabilities.
evidence: our use of AI in our supply chain and production operations

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: Historically, a few customers have represented a significant portion of revenues and total accounts receivable. Loss of any major customer could have a material adverse effect on business, operating results and financial condition. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of key customers could have a negative impact on revenues and financial position of the company.

risks.title: Third-Party Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Reliance on third parties for supply of services and raw materials essential to production could result in delays or interruptions in delivery of finished products. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Dependence on third parties for production and delivery of finished products could result in delays or interruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory inspections and FDA actions could have a negative impact on the company, particularly in case of non-compliance with regulatory requirements. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Regulatory risks, including inspections and FDA actions, could have a negative impact on the company.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks and security breaches could compromise confidential information and damage reputation. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Cybersecurity threats could have a negative impact on company reputation and operations.

risks.title: Product Quality
risks.score_rationale: Product quality issues could result in recalls, fines and loss of customer confidence. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Product quality issues could have a negative impact on company reputation and operations.

risks.title: Pandemic or Epidemic
risks.score_rationale: A pandemic or epidemic could have a negative impact on the company due to supply chain and production disruptions. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: A pandemic or epidemic could have a negative impact on the company due to supply chain and production disruptions.

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.score_rationale: Ability to maintain profitability and generate positive cash flows is uncertain, and the company may need additional financing to support operations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Financial risks, particularly ability to maintain profitability, could have a negative impact on company financial position.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
